name: isNat_sqrt
statement: {x nx z : ℕ} → IsNat x nx → Nat.sqrt nx = z → IsNat (Nat.sqrt x) z | _, _, _, ⟨rfl⟩, rfl => ⟨rfl⟩  /-- Given the natural number literal `ex`, returns its square root as a natural number literal and an equality proof. Panics if `ex` isn't a natural number literal. -/ def proveNatSqrt (ex : Q(ℕ)) : (ey : Q(ℕ)) × Q(Nat.sqrt $ex = $ey)
